scripts.db:create: cd packages/api && wrangler d1 create canchapro-db
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/api && wrangler d1 migrations apply canchapro-db --local
scripts.db:seed: cd packages/api && wrangler d1 execute canchapro-db --local --file=migrations/0002_seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: cd packages/api && rm -rf .wrangler/state && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
